WITH major_groups AS (
    SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member
    GROUP BY link_to_major
),
group_shares AS (
    SELECT member_count,
           CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM major_groups
),
averaged AS (
    SELECT member_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM group_shares
)
SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM averaged
WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: Members with a NULL link_to_major are grouped together as one missing-major group; all members are included in the total.
